scientific_integrity: Exact all-frequency conclusions rest on the analytic proof. The supplied numerical verifier is finite and independently auditable; no claim of external validation, originality certification, or independent review is made.
scientific_limitations: This proves a logarithmic limsup for arbitrary irrational angles, not a full limit. Two-sided power estimates need bounded continued-fraction type and have angle-dependent constants. The setting is L2 circle Fourier multipliers with fixed 0<s<=2; a finite checker corroborates but does not establish infinite claims. Closest accessible literature does not establish historical priority exhaustively.
title: Fractional circle smoothing detects the antipodal Diophantine exponent
